title: Setting up your spare Mac for Claude Code to control, a step-by-step guide
summary: A practical step-by-step guide for configuring a spare Mac to be controlled by Claude Code (Anthropic's AI CLI tool), enabling remote AI-driven desktop automation through natural language commands.
problem_solved: Enables users to repurpose an old Mac as an AI-controlled automation workstation that can be commanded remotely via CLI.
why_valuable: Makes AI desktop automation accessible by using readily available spare hardware, lowering the barrier to practical AI agent workflows.
